clue.text: Like a drip, crow about enjoying America? — the opposite

indicators.note: about would put the bird around the other word, but the clue then reverses that order
the opposite tells the solver to swap which piece goes round which

parts.note: into means keen on, enjoying
the raven is a large crow
US is the United States

explanation.surface: A query about whether someone crowing over their good time in America is like a drip, apparently unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, RAVEN goes about INTO; 'the opposite' flips it so INTO goes about RAVEN, giving INTRAVENO, then US.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospital drip feeds fluid straight into a vein, so it is a vein-entering method.

clue.text: Fish leaves rock band to make superhero movie

indicators.note: leaves means departs, so the fish is taken out of the band

parts.note: Iron Maiden is a British heavy metal band
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A singer called Fish quits a rock group to make a film.
explanation.walkthrough: Fish was also a rock singer, which supports the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The 2008 Marvel film about Tony Stark in his armoured suit.

clue.text: Salad ingredient mother's fed to dog

indicators.note: fed to means placed inside, so the mother goes into the dog

parts.note: Toto is Dorothy's dog in The Wizard of Oz
ma is mother

explanation.surface: Mum's salad is being fed to the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A red fruit commonly sliced into a green salad.

clue.text: Top grade examining body set to right

parts.note: A star, A*, is the top exam grade in Britain
an exam board sets and marks exams

explanation.surface: An exam board sets things right on the top grade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set' joins the pieces; the board 'sets' exams in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the starboard side is the right, so this means towards that side.

clue.text: Direction of Dawn French is encompassing acting, initially

indicators.note: encompassing means surrounding, so the French word goes round a letter

parts.note: est is French for is

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of acting

explanation.surface: Comedian Dawn French and her acting career.
explanation.walkthrough: Dawn French is a British comic actress; here 'Dawn' belongs to the definition and 'French' signals a language.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun rises in that quarter, so daybreak comes from that compass point.

clue.text: Curious to peer at the Student Prince?

indicators.note: curious means odd, so the letters form an odd arrangement

explanation.surface: A curious urge to peek at a prince who is a student.
explanation.definitionFit: The Student Prince is a 1924 Romberg light opera, an example shown by the question mark.

clue.text: Really performing rap? Certainly not me

definitions.text: Really performing rap? Certainly not me

parts.note: so means really, as in so good

indicators.note: performing means in action, so the letters of rap are put to work in a new order

parts.note: no is a flat refusal

explanation.surface: A classical singer refuses to do rap.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is spoken by the singer: an opera voice would never perform rap.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest female classical voice, the kind of singer who stays well away from hip hop.

clue.text: Washer woman (French) beset by rubbish

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so the rubbish word encloses the woman

parts.note: grot is British slang for rubbish
Mme, Madame, is the French title for a woman

explanation.surface: A French washerwoman surrounded by rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Washer woman' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'Washer'.
explanation.definitionFit: A grommet is a ring or eyelet, a kind of washer used to protect a hole.

clue.text: Dairy product sourced from butter

parts.note: butter is not the spread but an animal that butts with its horns

explanation.surface: A dairy item made from butter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butter' means one that butts: the animal with horns.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft white cheese made from the milk of a horned farm animal known for butting.

clue.text: Support inobtrusive spy

definitions.meaning: a railway tie supporting the rails
an agent planted to lie dormant until activated

explanation.surface: A spy who keeps a low profile and props things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Railway ties are called this in Britain, and a dormant agent goes by the same name.

clue.text: Sees through holiday hazard warning

parts.note: to rumble someone is British slang for seeing through their deceit
a trip is a short holiday

explanation.surface: Someone sees through a holiday scam.
explanation.definitionFit: Raised ridges on a road make tyres vibrate to alert drivers to danger ahead.

clue.text: One's wound from weapon character first fired

parts.note: an arm is a weapon

indicators.note: fired means sacked, so the opening letter of the word for character is dismissed

parts.note: nature means character or temperament

explanation.surface: Someone hurt by a weapon that a character fired first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's wound' looks like an injury but means something that is wound, as wire is coiled.
explanation.definitionFit: In a motor or generator, the rotating part carries coils of wire wound around it.

clue.text: Medal sunny state's secured still

indicators.note: secured means held fast, so the medal holds the state inside it

parts.note: BEM is the British Empire Medal
Cal is short for California, the sunshine state

explanation.surface: A medal won by sunny California kept something motionless.
explanation.definitionFit: To still something is to make it calm and quiet, as wind dropping strands a ship.

clue.text: Shutting up about husband that's tight

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shutting word goes round the husband

parts.note: closeting means shutting away in a private room

explanation.surface: Someone clams up about a stingy spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tight' suggests stingy, but here it means a narrow margin.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape or very tight contest is a near miss.

clue.text: Smooth author

definitions.meaning: to rub a surface flat with abrasive paper

explanation.surface: A writer with a polished style.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrading wood makes it smooth, and George Sand was the pen name of a nineteenth-century French novelist.

clue.text: Internet abuser after material — one means to scrape the bottom

definitions.text: one means to scrape the bottom

indicators.note: after places the abuser behind the material in the answer

parts.note: toile is a linen or cotton fabric
a troll posts abuse online

explanation.surface: An online troll who follows the fabric trade is scraping the barrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrape the bottom' suggests sinking low, but here it is literal wiping.
explanation.definitionFit: Lavatory paper is used for wiping one's behind, a literal reading of the idiom.

clue.text: Wounded hero, I'm keeping watch in part of estate

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the rearranged letters hold the watch word
wounded means hurt or damaged, so the letters are disordered

parts.note: lo means look, see

explanation.surface: An injured hero keeps watch over part of an estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A family treasure passed down is part of what a person leaves in a will.

clue.text: Tacky ornament!

parts.note: tacky reads as vulgar, but tack is a horse's harness gear, and this ornament is attached to it

explanation.surface: A cheap, vulgar decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: Tack is riding equipment for horses (saddle, bridle, harness), so a 'tacky' ornament belongs on the tack.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative brass plaque hung on a working horse's harness, now often a pub wall trinket.

clue.text: Revolutionary sort of tyre keeping cold

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the tyre type holds the cold letter

parts.note: a radial is a type of tyre
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A revolutionary tyre design keeps cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' fits a turning tyre, but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A reformer seeking sweeping change is an extremist or rebel.

clue.text: Book entertainers

definitions.meaning: a New Testament book about the apostles
performers on a bill, each one a turn

explanation.surface: Booking some performers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acts of the Apostles is a Bible book, and performers on a variety bill are called turns or this.

clue.text: Aspect of chart-topper playing all over the country

indicators.note: topper in a down clue means the top, first letter of chart

parts.note: on means playing, being performed
a tour goes all over the country

explanation.surface: A chart-topping band touring the country.
explanation.definitionFit: An outline or shape of something, as in the contours of an argument.

clue.text: Worked in school experiencing stress that's pronounced

indicators.note: pronounced signals a word heard, not spelt

parts.note: taut means stretched tight, under tension

explanation.surface: A schoolteacher under pronounced stress.
explanation.definitionFit: A teacher who has worked in a school has instructed pupils, so the past tense of teach.

clue.text: Stay close by river

parts.note: the close of something is its end
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Remain near a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay the course is to last or hold out to the finish.

clue.text: Son's given teacher riddle

parts.note: a trainer teaches skills

explanation.surface: A boy is set a puzzle by his teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riddle' looks like a puzzle but is a coarse sieve.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a large sieve for soil or grain, so a sieving utensil.

clue.text: Wedding vow left one adored

parts.note: I do is said at the altar

explanation.surface: A jilted lover who had made a wedding vow.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who is worshipped or idolised, an object of adoration.

clue.text: Obscure clue Don composed

indicators.note: composed means put together, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: An academic named Don writes a baffling crossword clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To cover with cloud is to darken or hide, a verb sense of obscure.

clue.text: Ringo fans at university forming a clique

indicators.note: fans means spreads out, so the drummer's name is scattered

parts.note: up means in residence at a university

explanation.surface: Students who adore Ringo Starr form their own club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fans' looks like admirers but is a verb that spreads letters out.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclusive social group whose members favour each other, the same as a closed coterie.

clue.text: Difficult situation held by weaker worker long since abandoned

indicators.note: held by means contained, so the weaker word encloses the situation

parts.note: lamer means feebler, weaker
a plight is a difficult situation

explanation.surface: A weaker worker is let go during a crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: Street gas lamps were once lit by hand each evening, a job that disappeared with electric lighting.
